name: Comparison of records
descriptor: Pick two records, and see them field by field, with the better value in each row marked.
verify_checks: versus: the better value is marked
pros: two records, every field, no scrolling between cards
matching fields are called out, so the eye goes to the differences
the better numeric value is marked, and a tie marks neither
it is a picker, so it works on any two records without a spec change
cons: two records at a time, not three
the better direction must be stated per field: a rating and a price do not both improve downward
long text fields are truncated to keep the table readable
best_for: choosing between two options you already have
avoid_if: you need to score or rank many records
